description: High-confidence detections require approval before any action proceeds. Class D tools block under active enforcement. Medium-confidence detections warn. Low-confidence detections log only. Use when FP rate is below acceptable threshold and the organization is ready to gate high-risk tool activity.
note: Active enforcement (process kill, network block) is reserved for explicit block rules on Class D tools. Switch posture to 'active' only after completing a dry-run review under 'audit' posture and confirming block precision.

policy_overrides.description: Medium confidence band: log and notify analyst
High confidence band: hold pending analyst approval
Class D tools: block under active enforcement. This rule has no effect while posture is 'audit'; switch posture to 'active' to enforce.
Drift detection rule: escalate to warn so capability loss is surfaced to analysts
Drift detection rule: escalate to warn
Drift detection rule: escalate to warn

overlay_rules.description: Elevate exfiltration risk signals to approval_required regardless of confidence band
Elevate credential access risk signals at Medium or High confidence to approval_required

tradeoffs.fp_exposure: higher — approval_required decisions hold activity pending review; a false positive at High confidence blocks legitimate tool use until an analyst resolves it
tradeoffs.coverage: maximum signal fidelity; all high-risk activity is gated; Class D tools can be blocked under active posture
tradeoffs.recommended_duration: sustained production use after pilot exit; not suitable for initial deployment without first completing visibility-only and warn-heavy phases
